description: NaLiHo₂F₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.55 Å. Li is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted corner-sharing LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and four longer (2.25 Å) Li-F bond lengths. Ho is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Ho-F bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Li and two equivalent Ho atoms to form distorted FLi₂Ho₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Ho₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent FNaLiHo₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent FNaLiHo₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Li, and two equivalent Ho atoms to form distorted FNaLiHo₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Ho₂ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent FNaLiHo₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FLi₂Ho₂ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent FNaLiHo₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms.
